title: Moderated session, participant's hands
prompt: Documentary photograph of a moderated mobile usability session in a small, bright research room in an Australian office: seen over the participant's shoulder, only their hands are visible holding a smartphone whose screen is a soft out-of-focus blur of pale colour blocks with nothing readable; across a timber table the moderator's hands rest beside a blank open notebook and a pen, a glass of water nearby, a closed laptop at the edge of frame. Natural late-morning window light, shallow depth of field, calm and attentive mood.
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
